sonnet.problem: The question says the LORD will "besiege her" and then asks "With what?". The right answer, "Towers and siege works", contains a form of that word (siege), so the question partly gives away its own answer.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.

sonnet.problem: Verse 11 is conditional: "If it is handed to someone to read…". The card says "somebody's about to get handed it". That drops the "if" and adds a timing the text doesn't give.
The card only restates what cards 6 and 7 already asked (one says it's sealed, the other can't read) and adds a joke. It tells no new part of the passage.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.
